1. All axial clearances are to be measured with the rotors in 
 forward 
 position against the loaded thrust face.
 2. Refer to clearance diagram for specified dimensions
 3. Take readings with rotor positioned as follows:
 a. Position 1L with # 1 
 bolt hole of comp. rotor at left
 b. Position 3R with # 3 
 bolt hole of comp. rotor at right
 c. Position 1R with # 1 
 bolt hole of comp. rotor at right
 4. After all 
 upper casings are bolted in place and the unit placed on 
 its own supports, the rotor tip clearances are to be measured and 
 recorded at the right below. All views are with turbine flow.
